rounds.hypothesis: A sliding window context management that pins the task instruction and keeps the last N assistant turns will improve pass rate by reducing context noise and keeping relevant history visible.

Adding a search memory system that tracks previous queries and their results will help the agent avoid redundant searches and recognize when it's stuck in a loop, improving pass rate on multi-hop tasks.
Adding search loop detection to the agent loop that tracks query similarity and forces the agent to change search strategy when repetition is detected will improve pass rates on multi-hop tasks.

When agents detect a search loop, providing concrete alternative search queries derived from the task question will help them escape the loop more effectively than a generic nudge, improving pass rates.

Enhancing SearchMemory to store richer outcome summaries (key findings, dead ends, success/failure context) and recall them in a more actionable format will improve the agent's ability to plan effective searches on multi-hop tasks beyond what R2's basic query-result history provides.
